post.description: Consume a one-time edge-minted login context and exchange the verified Korve user session for a scoped application access token. API clients send `x-korve-access-token: <token>`; Authorization remains reserved for customer application auth. Browsers submit the token to the server-returned callback; the edge responds 303 with `__Host-korve_access=<encoded token>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/` and no Domain attribute. The central API never trusts browser callback, project, or scope parameters and never sets a cross-origin cookie.
